note: Concurrent releases (crates/DESIGN.md, "Concurrent releases"): the releases "2003 - 2004" and "2004 - 2005" of `conc/t` both deliver 2004. An order over 2003-2005 that names no release blocks with one `release_ambiguous` for 2004, located at the source and listing both releases; 2003 and 2005 alone would order. Fails if a shared day is served from both releases (a silent union) or from one picked silently. Oracle: the fixture's JSONL.
